# Hardware / software interface - WWAN carrier rev 0.2

Generated from the KiCad netlist plus the semantic table in `tools/gen_interface.py`. Rerun `python3 tools/gen_interface.py` (or `tools/regen_hardware.sh`) after any schematic change; CI runs `--check`.

## 1. I2C devices

One host I2C bus enters on the host header J801 (3.3 V). The PCIe switch sits behind a PCA9306 level translator (1.8 V side).

| Ref | Device | 7-bit address | Bus | Source / note | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| U301 | PI7C9X3G606GP | 0x6F | host I2C via U304 PCA9306 (1.8 V side) | Diodes DS43484 Rev 5-2 sec. I2C: default 1101111b (0x6F), programmable at cfg offset 318h. The same section's example tables show 68h - confirm with i2cdetect | **VERIFY** |
| U705 | USB5744 | 0x2D | host I2C (3.3 V) | Linux DT binding microchip,usb5744.yaml example (usb-hub@2d); not stated in DS00001855J text | **VERIFY** |
| U801 | TCA6416A | 0x20 | host I2C (3.3 V) | ADDR pin on GND - TI SCPS194F Table 8-3: ADDR=L -> 0x20, ADDR=H -> 0x21 (derived from the ADDR pin net) | from netlist + datasheet |
| U802 | TCA6416A | 0x21 | host I2C (3.3 V) | ADDR pin on +3V3 - TI SCPS194F Table 8-3: ADDR=L -> 0x20, ADDR=H -> 0x21 (derived from the ADDR pin net) | from netlist + datasheet |
| U704 | HD3SS3220 | - | - | ADDR pin unconnected -> GPIO mode, I2C not used (TI SLLSEN5) | from netlist + datasheet |

Bus pull-ups found in the netlist: R709 10k to +3V3; R802 4.7k to +3V3 (DNP); R710 10k to +3V3; R803 4.7k to +3V3 (DNP).

Notes:
- USB5744 is strapped for **SMBus slave mode** (10 k pull-ups on SMCLK/SMDAT). In that mode the hub waits **indefinitely** in its SOC_CFG stage until the host finishes configuration (DS00001855J sec. 5.1.5). Linux `onboard_usb_dev` (`CONFIG_USB_ONBOARD_DEV_USB5744`) sends the attach command (SMBus write-word, command 0xAA, data 0x0056); `carrierctl.py hub-attach` does the same from userspace. Until this happens **no slot enumerates over USB**. **VERIFY** on hardware.
- PI7C9X3G606GP I2C is for configuration/debug only; normal operation needs no I2C traffic (transparent switch).

TCA6416A facts used above (TI SCPS194F): after power-on reset or RESET# all pins are inputs (config regs 0x06/0x07 = 0xFF) and the output registers 0x02/0x03 default to 0xFF (sec. 8.6.3). If firmware writes the config register first, every output would immediately drive **1** (slots powered, FCPO# released, modules in reset, RF disabled). Always write the output registers first. The expander has no internal pull resistors, so the "board default" column is set by the carrier resistors only.

## 3. PCIe topology

Host: FRDM-IMX95 M.2 Key-M (PCIe Gen3 x1) -> ADT-Link M41 riser cable -> carrier x1 edge fingers -> PI7C9X3G606GP upstream port 0. Switch strapped PORTCFG[2:0]=101 (6-port/6-lane), CKMODE=0 (host REFCLK), hot-plug disabled (HOT_PLUG_EN_L=1).

| Slot | Connector | Switch lane | Switch port | REFCLK out | CLKREQ# net | PERST# source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | J401 | 1 | P1 | REFCLKO1 | `SLOT1_CLKREQ_N` | `SLOT1_PERST_N` = host PERST# AND SLOT1_PCIE_EN (TP403.1 (SLOT1_PERST_N), U401.4 (SN74LVC1G08DCKR)) |
| 2 | J501 | 2 | P4 | REFCLKO4 | `SLOT2_CLKREQ_N` | `SLOT2_PERST_N` = host PERST# AND SLOT2_PCIE_EN (TP503.1 (SLOT2_PERST_N), U501.4 (SN74LVC1G08DCKR)) |
| 3 | J601 | 3 | P5 | REFCLKO5 | `SLOT3_CLKREQ_N` | `SLOT3_PERST_N` = host PERST# AND SLOT3_PCIE_EN (TP603.1 (SLOT3_PERST_N), U601.4 (SN74LVC1G08DCKR)) |

Ports P6/P7 are unused (lanes 4/5 NC).

Expected `lspci -tvnn` (bus numbers illustrative; **VERIFY** downstream device numbers and whether unused ports P6/P7 still appear as bridges):

```
-[0000:00]---00.0-[01-ff]--  i.MX 95 root port
    \-[01]---00.0  Pericom/Diodes PI7C9X3G606GP upstream port   [12d8:c008]
        +-[02] DSP P1 --- 00.0  Qualcomm SDX65 MHI (Telit FN990A28)  [17cb:0308 sub 1c5d:2010]  driver mhi-pci-generic
        +-[03] DSP P4 --- 00.0  Qualcomm SDX65 MHI (Sierra EM9291)   [17cb:0308 sub 18d7:0301]  driver mhi-pci-generic
        +-[04] DSP P5 --- 00.0  (any of the above / future NTN M.2 card)
        +-[05] DSP P6 (no link)
        \-[06] DSP P7 (no link)
```

IDs: switch 12d8:c008 from DS43484 sec. 9.3.1/9.3.2 (vendor 12D8h, device C008h). Module IDs from mainline `drivers/bus/mhi/host/pci_generic.c` (entries "Telit FN990" 1c5d:2010 and "EM929x (sdx65)" 18d7:0301); the slot assignment above is only an example. **VERIFY** on hardware that FN990A28 reports subsystem 1c5d:2010 (an unknown subsystem still binds via the generic 17cb:0308 entry).

## 4. USB topology

Host USB3 Type-C (FRDM) -> carrier USB-C J701 (UFP) -> HD3SS3220 (orientation mux, GPIO mode) -> USB5744 upstream. USB5744 port 4 disabled by strap; ports 1-3 non-removable.

| Slot | Connector | USB5744 port | USB2 D+ | Module USB3 TX -> hub | Hub USB3 TX -> module RX |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | J401 | 1 | USB2DN_DP1/PRT_DIS_P1 | USB3DN_RXDP1 | USB3DN_TXDP1 (via C708 100nF) |
| 2 | J501 | 2 | USB2DN_DP2/PRT_DIS_P2 | USB3DN_RXDP2 | USB3DN_TXDP2 (via C710 100nF) |
| 3 | J601 | 3 | USB2DN_DP3/PRT_DIS_P3 | USB3DN_RXDP3 | USB3DN_TXDP3 (via C712 100nF) |

USB is always wired. Telit FN990: with pin 20 LOW (PCIe mode) USB is debug-only; with `SLOTn_PCIE_SEL`=0 at boot the card boots USB-only (USB 3.1 Gen2 / USB 2.0, HDG Table 29). Sierra EM92xx: interfaces are mutually exclusive; USB needs PCIE_DIS driven to 1.8 V (fit the DNP 10k pin-20 pull-up to +1V8) and normally VBUS_SENSE high on pin 22 (fit the DNP 10k to the slot rail - Sierra only).

## 7. Host header J801 (2x5, 2.54 mm)

| Pin | Net | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `GND` |  |
| 2 | `GND` |  |
| 3 | `I2C_SCL` | host I2C, 3.3 V. Bus pull-ups 10 k on the hub sheet (SMBus strap), 4.7 k DNP here |
| 4 | `I2C_SDA` | host I2C, 3.3 V. Bus pull-ups 10 k on the hub sheet (SMBus strap), 4.7 k DNP here |
| 5 | `EXP_INT_N` | open-drain wired-OR INT# of both TCA6416A, 10 k pull-up; connect to a host GPIO with IRQ |
| 6 | `EXP_RESET_N` | RESET# of both TCA6416A, 10 k pull-up; host GPIO, active low |
| 7 | `NC` |  |
| 8 | `CARRIER_3V3_SENSE` | 1 k from +3V3: reads high when the carrier +3V3 rail is up |
| 9 | `GND` |  |
| 10 | `GND` |  |

Mapping to FRDM-IMX95 header pins (which LPI2C instance, which GPIO for INT#/RESET#) is **not decided**; see docs/open-issues.md. Host I/O must be 3.3 V (**VERIFY** the FRDM header voltage).
